title: `final` on a class constant is accepted and has no effect.
text: `final` on a property and `static` on a constant are `E0106`, but `final public const int N = 1;` compiles, and a subclass that redeclares `N` compiles too and reads its own value. No rule says what `final` on a constant means. It closes when `final` on a constant is either `E0106` or stops a redeclaration with a diagnostic, decided in a rule, with a conformance case.
